entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Artificer captured during the Tomakul Campaign and imprisoned in the Oubliette.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's artificer sent to torture Tawnos, who secretly helped him escape and was banished.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Ruler who banished Ashnod and set his sights on Terisia City.

entities.name: Oubliette
entities.description: Fallaji prison cell in Tomakul that opens only from the top.

entities.name: Tomakul Campaign
entities.description: Campaign during which Tawnos was captured.

entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: Staff Tawnos fashioned from a skull and wire.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Whispered in Mishra's ear, turning him against Ashnod.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: Empire from which Ashnod was banished.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City where Ashnod fled and Mishra's next campaign target.

events.summary: Tawnos was surrounded by enemy troops, captured and put in the Oubliette.
events.quote: Tawnos was surrounded by enemy troops and captured

events.summary: Sent by Mishra to torture Tawnos, Ashnod used the rack only for show and slipped him powerstone earrings and wire to make a Staff of Zegon.
events.quote: she slipped him her powerstone earrings and the wire needed for him to fashion his own Staff of Zegon

events.summary: Tawnos drained the guards' strength with the staff and escaped.
events.quote: Tawnos used his makeshift staff to drain the guards' strength

events.summary: Mishra, whispered to by the Brotherhood of Gix, banished Ashnod from Fallaji lands.
events.quote: he did not believe her and banished her from any lands belonging to the Fallaji Empire

events.summary: Ashnod left on a horse for Terisia City, and Mishra set his sights on that city.
events.quote: he set his sights on that very city for his next campaign

relations.note: Sent by him to torture Tawnos.
relations.quote: Ashnod was sent by Mishra to torture him
she slipped him her powerstone earrings
The Brotherhood of Gix had whispered in his ears
